title: Genie Agents enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Guided agent creation**: A guided experience now walks you through creating an effective Genie Agent. See [Set up an agent with Genie Code](/aws/en/genie-agents/set-up#build-with-genie-code).
* **Faster file retrieval (Beta)**: Genie Agents now retrieve files faster when answering questions. See [How content search works](/aws/en/genie-agents/volumes#content-search).
* **Content search details hidden from viewers (Beta)**: The context panel no longer shows technical content search details, such as the number of files indexed, to users with CAN VIEW or CAN RUN permission on a Genie Agent. See [How content search works](/aws/en/genie-agents/volumes#content-search).
* **Volume file links in embedded agents**: Links to volume files in an embedded Genie Agent now open the file instead of redirecting users to the workspace. See [Embed a Genie Agent in an external app](/aws/en/genie-agents/embed).
